name: Midoumae Momoka
source:
The daughter of the Midoumae Group, descended from an old zaibatsu. Not only is she the school's most beautiful girl, she also possesses M-cup breasts. She holds the position of Student Council President, earning deep trust from both teachers and students, and excels academically.

However, her extreme naivety about the world causes her to occasionally display airheaded behavior.
